KarteaIniDefaults

class KarteaIniDefaults[source]

Bases: object

Default values of kartea.ini and conversion of the values read.

Class with only class attributes and class methods, following the KarteaPathConfig pattern: it is not instantiated.

Attributes:
TABLEdict[str, IniDefault], class attribute

Configuration field -> (section, key, converter, default as text). The order defines the order of the sections and keys in the generated file.

Methods

sections

Return the content of the default kartea.ini.

to_bool

Convert a boolean read from the .ini ("true"/"false").

to_float

Convert a decimal read from the .ini ("0.5" or "0,5").

value

Return the default value of a configuration field.
static to_float(value)[source]

Convert a decimal read from the .ini (“0.5” or “0,5”).

Parameters:
valueAny

Text or number read from the .ini.

Returns:
float

The number, or 0.0 if it is not a number.

Examples

>>> KarteaIniDefaults.to_float("0,5")
0.5
static to_bool(value)[source]

Convert a boolean read from the .ini (“true”/”false”).

Parameters:
valueAny

Text or bool read from the .ini.

Returns:
bool

True for “true”, “1”, “yes” or “sim” (case-insensitive); False for any other text. A bool is returned as is.

Examples

>>> KarteaIniDefaults.to_bool(" Sim ")
True
classmethod sections()[source]

Return the content of the default kartea.ini.

Returns:
dict[str, dict[str, str]]

{section: {key: default value as text}}.

Examples

>>> ini = KarteaIniDefaults.sections()
>>> ini["game_settings"]["level_time_default"]
'120'
classmethod value(field, ini)[source]

Return the default value of a configuration field.

Parameters:
fieldstr

Configuration field (key of TABLE).

inidict[str, dict[str, str]]

kartea.ini already read (KarteaPathConfig.read_config).

Returns:
Any

The kartea.ini value or, if the key does not exist, the table default; converted to the field type.

Raises:
KeyError

If field is not in TABLE.

Examples

>>> KarteaIniDefaults.value("level_time", {})
120
>>> KarteaIniDefaults.value(
...     "hud", {"interface_settings": {"hud_default": "false"}}
... )
False
